title: Chapter 271 The Nine-Clawed Dragon
content:
Chapter 271 The Nine-Clawed Dragon

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly remembered something, and then turned her head to look at the light blue dragon egg beside her.

"Ten years, ten years, Xiaoqing, you won't be really dead, right?"

Holding Long Dan in his arms, Lu Xue smiled bitterly on her face and kept stroking the Long Dan in her arms.

And just then.

Click—

A slight crack suddenly appeared from the surface of the dragon egg.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue was slightly stunned and then suddenly became ecstatic.

"Xiaoqing!"

boom!

The extremely cold air gushed out from the tiny crack, and the entire training room instantly entered the ice age.

At the same time, above Zhuyun Peak.

A breath that came from ancient times continued to permeate the void.

The roar of the dragon sounded.

Everyone looked in horror and saw an extremely huge phantom of ancient ice dragon slowly emerging from the void.

His mouth was like a river, and the cold air emitted from his body, even though it was far apart, still made people feel trembling.

"Then, what is that?!"

A student from Tiandi Academy turned pale and collapsed on the ground.

The terrifying dragon power attacked, and most of the people present looked uncomfortable.

What a terrifying blood pressure!

"Dragon, there are actually dragons in the academy!"

"Wait, look at it! His claws!!"

Another person suddenly exclaimed, his eyes full of disbelief.

On the competition stand.

The young man holding the knife also stood up at this moment, looking at the void in the distance with a serious expression.

"This, how is this possible? There are actually nine-clawed extreme dragons in the world."

The boy holding the knife had a heavy voice, and what appeared in his mind was the legend he had heard.

Legend has it that there is a supreme creature in the dragon clan. It has nine claws and pure bloodlines, which is the absolute king of the dragon clan.

The dragon clan is a very powerful race.

As the king of the dragon clan, his strength is naturally extremely terrifying.

Nine represents the extreme.

Nine-clawed Dragon!

"This trip seems to have not been in vain."

At this moment, a confident smile appeared on the face of the young man holding the knife again, and he kept stroking the broken knife in his hand, and a stream of knife aura continued to permeate.

At this time, Zhuyunfeng practice room.

The dragon egg has been completely broken.

Ao Qing's body was suspended in front of Lu Xue, her eyes closed, and the pure energy in her body was constantly pouring into Ao Qing's body.

After a long time, Ao Qing suddenly opened his eyes.

The early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm suddenly surged out of its body.

A whistle.

Ao Qing was about to soar into the sky, reaching the sky, showing his kingly power and supreme pressure.

However, Ao Qing had just flew up, and the next moment, he was suddenly pulled down.

"Damn, what are you doing!"

Ao Qing scolded angrily, about to get angry.

"Um?"

What you meet is a familiar face.

"Uh, my master, long time no see you."

Ao Qing smiled awkwardly and hurriedly penetrated into Lu Xue's arms.

But Lu Xue didn't appreciate it and directly lifted Ao Qing up.

"You boy, let me wait."

Although Lu Xue was very happy, she still made a sneering expression.

"My master, I don't want to do it either, but the master gave it too much, and I can't stand it."

Listen to Ao Qing's Versailles.

Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

"Hmph, I'm full this time, don't stop doing anything."

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing nodded repeatedly, "Don't worry, as long as the Immortal Emperor Realm does not come out, I will be invincible!"

Immortal Emperor Realm. .

Lu Xue sighed.

Now that I want to move myself, who is not the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm?

You can uselessness below the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Lu Xue waved her hand and said, "Let's go out with me first."

After ten years of seclusion, I don’t know how it is going outside.

Chasing under the Cloud Peak.

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked shocked.

"That's Ao Qing!"

"He has been so terrifying for ten years."

"Oh, it seems that our improvement is nothing."

The two of them shook their heads slightly and then they were about to go up the mountain.

And at this moment, Lu Xue and Ao Qing suddenly appeared under Zhuyun Peak.

"Huh? It's you two?"

As soon as he came out, Lu Xue bumped into two people head-on.

"Sister Xue."

When they saw Lu Xue, the two of them hurriedly said hello.

"What have you done in the past ten years? You won't be waiting for me all the time, right?"

Lu Xue looked at the two of them and asked immediately.

The middle stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

With just one glance, Lu Xue could see the cultivation of the two.

The fourth level of Xiaoluo Immortal Saint Realm.

Qin Feng’s Immortal Saint Realm Sixth Level.

Both of them have made great progress in the past ten years.

Moreover, it seems to have become a little different.

It seems that I have encountered some adventure.

When they heard Lu Xue’s questioning, the two of them immediately heard something wrong.

Sister Xue has been in Zhuyun Peak for ten years? !

"Uh, Sister Xue, we have been practicing in the secret realm for the past ten years and have just come out today."

At this time, Qin Feng said.

Facing Lu Xue, there is no need to lie.

Xiao Luo nodded repeatedly on the side.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was slightly surprised.

"It's such a coincidence that I've just been in seclusion for ten years."

"By the way, in which secret realm do you practice, and you have made great progress."

Which secret realm to practice?

As soon as this question arose, Qin Feng and the others trembled all over as if they were electrocuted.

"Ahem!"

Qin Feng coughed twice, then turned his head slightly and said, "This, let's ask Brother Xiao."

On the side, Xiao Luo looked at Lu Xue and looked at him, his heart slightly cold.

Taking a deep breath, a smile appeared on Xiao Luo's face.

"Uh, hahahaha, that thing, Sister Xue, that secret realm is rare in a million years, and it has been closed now, so it doesn't matter what secret realm it is. What is important is that it has improved our strength."

When Qin Feng heard this answer, he quickly agreed, "Ah yes yes, that's it."

Seeing that something was wrong with the two, Lu Xue frowned slightly, but didn't ask any more questions.

Since I don't say it, then forget it.

"Well, Sister Xue, when we came back, we seemed to see something happening on the competition stand. Should we go and have a look?"

At this time, Qin Feng spoke again.

Ao Qing also suddenly came out.

"My little master, I also felt a strong aura there."

Not weak aura.

Lu Xue was a little surprised. She knew Ao Qing's temperament, and he didn't like it.

Even Ao Qing said that he was not weak, so he was obviously very strong.

"Go and go and have a look."

Immediately, the three of them and one dragon headed towards the competition platform.

Meanwhile, in the square.

At this moment, everyone slowly recovered from the terrifying vision that Ao Qing emitted.

A young man holding a holy book slowly walked into the competition platform under the eyes of everyone.

"I'm under Lingqu, I want to compete with my brother."

Yu Lingqu is neither humble nor arrogant.

Everyone looked at Yu Lingqu, and the silent heart in their hearts ignited again.

"It's Senior Brother Yu, the tenth-ranked literary list!"

"What! Senior Brother Yu has come out of seclusion?!"

On the stage, the young man with a knife looked at Yu Lingqu in front of him and chuckled, "Look at you, a tender skin, aren't you afraid of swords without eyes."

"Brother is joking. Since he has been on this competition, Yu has already put life and death aside."

Hearing this, the boy holding the knife became interested.

"Haha, OK! Then come."
